basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/PolySwarm/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. [PolySwarm](https://polyswarm.io) is a threat intelligence platform built on a marketplace of competing detection engines. Files, URLs, IP addresses and domains are analyzed by multiple engines in parallel, their consensus is scored as a single PolyScore, PolyUnite identifies the malware family, and sandbox detonation adds behavioral analysis. This solution enriches Microsoft Sentinel incident entities (file hashes, URLs, IP addresses and domains) with PolySwarm's multi-engine malware verdicts, naming every engine that agreed, and lets an analyst detonate a URL, an email attachment, an Azure Storage blob, or a file retrieved directly from a device through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, in the PolySwarm sandbox, returning a score-derived verdict, malware family, MITRE ATT&CK techniques and a report link on the incident. Data connectors bring PolySwarm threat intelligence, from an organization's own PolySwarm hunt results and from the PolySwarm curated feed, into Microsoft Sentinel's native threat intelligence table, so Microsoft's built-in indicator matching runs against PolySwarm data alongside the analytics rules and hunting queries this solution provides. Coverage by indicator type: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, URL, domain and IP are answered. Email addresses are not supported, because PolySwarm has no endpoint for them. A small PolySwarm status workbook shows what has arrived from each connector, reading only your own workspace. Underlying Microsoft Technologies used: This solution depends on underlying Microsoft technologies. Some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs: * [Logic Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/logic-apps/logic-apps-pricing) * [Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector) * [Threat Indicators](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/upload-indicators-api) * [Key Vault](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/key-vault/general/pricing) **Data Connectors:** 2, **Workbooks:** 1, **Analytic Rules:** 3, **Hunting Queries:** 4, **Playbooks:** 15 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This solution installs workbook(s) to help you gain insights into the telemetry collected in Microsoft Sentinel. After installing the solution, start using the workbook in Manage solution view.

See what PolySwarm has delivered to this workspace: indicators from hunt results and the curated feed over time, connector health, sandbox detonations by verdict and alerts from the PolySwarm analytics rules. Reads only workspace tables.
This solution installs the following analytic rule templates. After installing the solution, create and enable analytic rules in Manage solution view.

Any PolySwarm hunting connector hit (ThreatIntelIndicators, SourceSystem "PolySwarm", with a hunt rule name) with
Confidence at or above 90 created in the last hour, grouped by malware family. Each hunt hit is counted once, on its SHA-256 indicator
(the SHA-1 and MD5 indicators of the same hit are skipped).
Confidence carries the PolyScore for the sample. Family and rule name come from
AdditionalFields.

Matches PolySwarm file-hash indicators (from live hunt results and the curated feed,
both landing in ThreatIntelIndicators with SourceSystem "PolySwarm") against
DeviceFileEvents, DeviceProcessEvents, SecurityEvent and CommonSecurityLog on SHA-256, SHA-1 and MD5 (both sides lowercased). The alert carries
the evidence: PolyScore, detection counts, malware family, hunt rule and report link.

Any PolySwarmSandbox_CL row with a malicious verdict becomes an incident. Covers both
file and URL detonations submitted through the enrichment playbooks. This is how a
PolySwarm sandbox verdict becomes an incident in the unified Defender portal, since the
playbooks that submit detonations only post an incident comment and never create an
incident themselves.
This solution installs the following hunting queries. After installing the solution, run these hunting queries to hunt for threats in Manage solution view.

PolySwarm domain correlation. Joins active PolySwarm domain indicators against
observed DNS lookups. This hunting query depends on PolySwarmHuntingCCFDefinition PolySwarmFeedCCFDefinition data connector (ThreatIntelIndicators ThreatIntelIndicators Parser or Table)

PolySwarm file-hash correlation. Joins active PolySwarm hash indicators against
observed file hashes on SHA-256, SHA-1 and MD5. This hunting query depends on PolySwarmHuntingCCFDefinition PolySwarmFeedCCFDefinition data connector (ThreatIntelIndicators ThreatIntelIndicators Parser or Table)

PolySwarm IP correlation. Joins active PolySwarm IP indicators against observed
network sessions. This hunting query depends on PolySwarmHuntingCCFDefinition PolySwarmFeedCCFDefinition data connector (ThreatIntelIndicators ThreatIntelIndicators Parser or Table)

PolySwarm URL correlation. Joins active PolySwarm URL indicators against observed web
sessions. This hunting query depends on PolySwarmHuntingCCFDefinition PolySwarmFeedCCFDefinition data connector (ThreatIntelIndicators ThreatIntelIndicators Parser or Table)

This solution installs the Playbook templates to help implement your Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) operations. After installing the solution, these will be deployed under Playbook Templates in the Automation blade in Microsoft Sentinel. They can be configured and managed from the Manage solution view in Content Hub.
